acceptance.given: An executable replay matrix contains an aggregate case whose validator does not terminate before the configured finite timeout.

oracle.expected: The replay aggregate records a deterministic unsuccessful timeout result and returns non-success within the configured finite time limit.
forbidden: The aggregate has no configured finite timeout.
The aggregate remains running beyond its configured time limit.
Budget exhaustion is reported as success.
oracle.observable: The replay command's bounded execution result and its aggregate receipt identify timeout/budget exhaustion as an unsuccessful terminal state.

acceptance.then: The aggregate has remained within its finite time bound or has terminated unsuccessfully because that bound was exhausted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the aggregate-time-bound assertion in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_package_replay.py with a deliberately non-terminating validator; it must fail if replay-matrix invokes validation without the configured finite timeout or treats exhaustion as success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make replay-matrix execute every aggregate validator invocation under one configured finite time/output budget and emit a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result when that budget is exhausted.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The change is limited to replay execution and receipt terminal-state handling; it introduces no persisted-state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: An aggregate execution becomes either a completed bounded evaluation or a deterministic unsuccessful budget-exhausted terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate command terminates within its configured finite time limit; a timeout/budget exhaustion result is non-success.

acceptance.given: A replay aggregate is supplied matrix-case evidence in which the same evidence identity is assigned to more than one required matrix case.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and returns non-success because matrix evidence is reused.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid despite reused matrix evidence.
The aggregate is accepted despite reused matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation result identifies reused matrix evidence as the invalidating condition and has a non-success terminal status.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalid because matrix evidence is reused.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the reused-evidence aggregate assertion in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_package_replay.py; it must fail if two matrix cases sharing one evidence identity produce an accepted aggregate.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate matrix evidence identity per required case during replay-matrix aggregate evaluation and invalidate the aggregate when an evidence identity is reused.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The change is limited to replay aggregate validity evaluation and introduces no persisted-state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: An aggregate evaluated with reused matrix evidence transitions to an invalid, non-accepted result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: An aggregate containing reused matrix evidence has invalid status and cannot be accepted.

acceptance.given: A candidate success evaluation is presented with matrix evidence whose bound input identity does not match the current matrix input identity.

oracle.expected: The stale-input case receives a non-success result and cannot produce aggregate success.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a stale-input case.
oracle.observable: The success-evaluation result reports stale input as a non-success condition rather than a passing matrix case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the stale-input success-rejection assertion in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_package_replay.py; it must fail if evidence bound to a different current matrix input is accepted as success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind each replay-matrix success decision to the current matrix input identity and reject success when the supplied case evidence is stale relative to that identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The change is limited to replay success evaluation and introduces no persisted-state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: A stale-input case presented for success evaluation transitions to a non-success result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No case with evidence bound to a non-current input identity can receive or contribute a success result.

acceptance.given: A replay aggregate is evaluated while required matrix evidence for at least one required matrix case is absent.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and returns non-success because required matrix evidence is missing.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid despite missing matrix evidence.
The aggregate is accepted despite missing matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation result identifies missing required matrix evidence as the invalidating condition and has a non-success terminal status.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalid because required matrix evidence is missing.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the missing-evidence aggregate assertion in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_package_replay.py; it must fail if an aggregate missing evidence for a required matrix case is accepted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require replay-matrix aggregate evaluation to account for evidence from every required matrix case and invalidate the aggregate when any required evidence is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The change is limited to replay aggregate validity evaluation and introduces no persisted-state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: An aggregate evaluated with missing required matrix evidence transitions to an invalid, non-accepted result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: An aggregate missing evidence for any required matrix case has invalid status and cannot be accepted.
